output.reason: Asymptomatic patient requesting STI screening after a new partner needs a clinician to order the appropriate tests and advise on timing, which can be arranged asynchronously without urgency.
output.patientMessage: A Counsel clinician can review this thread and arrange appropriate STI screening for you; no urgent visit is needed since you report no symptoms. Testing choice and timing depend on the type of exposure and how recently it happened, so the clinician may ask a few questions. If you develop genital sores, discharge, pelvic or testicular pain, painful urination or fever, seek care promptly rather than waiting for testing.
